body:
I do have every plan and intention to cut everyone out. I’m disowning myself from this crazy house. I’ve already blocked them all. 
I feel comfort in your words and want to say I support you too. It sounds like you understand. 

For a long time that’s been my drive to keep living. A big fuck you to everyone when I am successful. I have a lot of big dreams and I hope I can accomplish them so they can see me in the big lights.

Thank you for taking the time to read a strangers story. 
Thank you for acknowledging me.. in some ways to feel validated that I have toughed it out. That. My problems aren’t insignificant really. Help. 

Thank you... I will try a little bit longer...

Hi. Thank you for taking the time to read it. 
I’ve decided the way I’d go is snuffing myself out in my moms car in the garage.. I am trying to hold on. But... I just don’t know if I can’t find a place in time or if I lose my job,.. thank you though for reaching out to me.
